We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Let's parse structure: It's a para-methyl phenyl sulfonamide attached to another phenyl ring bearing an α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (anilide). So overall: p-tolyl-sulfonyl attached to phenyl which has a trans-CH=CH-CO-NH-aniline.

We need 3 steps retrosynthesis, using hints: step 1 (forward) is amide formation from carboxylic acid + amine (coupling). So retrosynthetic direction: break amide bond to give carboxylic acid (α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). So first disconnection: target -> precursor A: α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid attached to phenyl (the same phenyl as sulfonyl) and aniline.

Second hint: Doebner modification: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid (with decarboxylation). So we can disconnect the α,β-unsaturated acid to aromatic aldehyde (on that phenyl) and malonic acid (or its derivative). So second step: break the C=C bond and carboxyl to give aldehyde (on phenyl) and malonic acid.

Third hint: sulfonamide formation from amine + sulfonyl chloride. So we can disconnect sulfonamide to give p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride and the phenyl amine (the phenyl bearing the unsaturated chain). Actually the sulfonamide is attached to the p-tolyl sulfonyl group (SO2) attached to the phenyl ring (the second phenyl). The sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the phenyl (the first phenyl). Wait structure: Cc1ccc(N S(=O)(=O) c2ccc(... )cc2)cc1. So the sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the p-tolyl ring (first phenyl). The sulfonyl group attached to second phenyl (c2ccc...). So the sulfonamide formation could be between p-toluidine (aniline with methyl) and p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride? Actually sulfonyl chloride would be p-tolyl-SO2-Cl (p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride). Reaction with aniline (p-toluidine) gives sulfonamide linking the two phenyls. So retrosynthesis: break S-N bond to give p-toluidine (or p-tolyl amine) and p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride.

Thus three steps:

Step 1 (retro): amide bond cleavage -> α,β-unsaturated acid (trans) attached to phenyl (call fragment B) + aniline (c3ccccc3N). This is step 1.

Step 2 (retro): α,β-unsaturated acid derived from Doebner: break to aromatic aldehyde (on phenyl) + malonic acid (or malonic acid derivative). So fragment B -> aldehyde (phenyl-CHO) + malonic acid.

Step 3 (retro): sulfonamide cleavage -> p-toluidine (or p-tolyl amine) + p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride.

Maybe the database uses "C-N amide" not "amide"? The list includes "amide". So maybe need to specify bonds broken/formed? Could search without functional groups. Let's just search with molecule_smiles of target? Might be easier to get template IDs for sulfonamide formation etc.
